verdict.rationale: The axis applies: Qodo exposes an MCP server and CLI that agents connect to, so scoped agent credentials are a fair question. The pack has no evidence of issuing scoped or least-privilege API keys or tokens. The closest items are adjacent controls that do not count: workspace admins gating which users can access the Agentic Toolbox, and a local rwx process-permission toggle in the CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
